Write Python code that handles the callback and exchanges an authorization code for tokens using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
from auth0.v3.authentication import GetToken
from auth0.v3.management import Auth0

def handle_callback(
    client_id,
    client_secret,
    domain,
    code,
    redirect_uri
):
    # <GAP>
    token = GetToken(domain)
    credentials = token.oauth2_callback(code, redirect_uri)
    
    auth0 = Auth0(domain, client_id, client_secret)
    
    userinfo = auth0.users.get('me')
    
    return userinfo
    # </GAP>
